content.title: Google Plans $15 Billion Data Center in Biggest India Bet
content.summary: Alphabet Inc.’s Google aims to invest about $15 billion building an AI infrastructure hub in southern India over the next five years, making its biggest bet on the fast-growing country.  The US company outlined plans Tuesday for a data center in the port city of Visakhapatnam linked to new energy sources and a fiber-optic network.  Indian tycoon Gautam Adani said his company AdaniConneX would partner with Google on the project, along with Bharti Airtel, the country’s No. 2 wireless carrier.
